title: Antifragile: Things That Gain from Disorder
author: Nassim Nicholas Taleb
summary: Taleb introduces antifragility, the property of things that improve under stress and volatility, and applies it to finance, medicine, politics and daily life.
readIf: you want a bold, sprawling argument about uncertainty and resilience.
skipIf: you dislike digressions and combative style, or want a tidy practical guide.
